computation: exact lattice enumeration; no random trials; no physics; no model call

F0_finite_conjunction.objective: the existing obligation: every declared condition and predicate
F0_finite_conjunction.answers: whether the frozen candidate satisfied the declared finite conjunction
F0_finite_conjunction.cost: 67 runs when accepted; early stop possible only with a cancellation status

F1_fixed_exact_binomial_O1.answers: p_minus < q at level alpha after n pairs
F1_fixed_exact_binomial_O1.cannot_answer: per-condition conjunction; non-inferiority of the mean
F1_fixed_exact_binomial_O1.assumptions: independent fresh draws; frozen candidate, reference and scoring; within-pair dependence allowed
F1_fixed_exact_binomial_O1.validity: exact binomial tail; no optional stopping

F2_fixed_paired_binomial_O2.answers: g = p_plus - p_minus >= -epsilon at level alpha after n pairs
F2_fixed_paired_binomial_O2.cannot_answer: a bound on p_minus alone; per-condition conjunction
F2_fixed_paired_binomial_O2.assumptions: as F1; four tails at alpha/4 (arXiv:2609.10873v1 eq. 2)
F2_fixed_paired_binomial_O2.validity: exact; fixed batch; no optional stopping

S1_sequential_sprt_O1.answers: p_minus < q (accept) or a harmful disagreement observed (reject) at any stopping time
S1_sequential_sprt_O1.validity: Wald likelihood ratio against the point alternative p_minus = 0; Ville's inequality; exactly valid under optional stopping

S2_sequential_betting_O2.answers: g > -epsilon (accept) or g < -epsilon (reject) at any stopping time
S2_sequential_betting_O2.cannot_answer: a bound on p_minus alone; per-condition conjunction
S2_sequential_betting_O2.assumptions: as F1 across pairs; a fixed predictable rate
S2_sequential_betting_O2.validity: nonnegative supermartingale under each null; Ville's inequality; the form of N-SCORE equation 3 with a margin, not its optimized rate nor its code

S3_sequential_betting_O3_superiority.cannot_answer: non-inferiority, harmful-disagreement bounds, per-condition or per-group requirements
S3_sequential_betting_O3_superiority.validity: as S2 with epsilon = 0; on binary success only in this study

P1_peeking_fixed_interval.validity: invalid: a fixed-sample interval inspected after every pair

lower_bound_for_any_valid_test.statement: Let T be any test of H0: p_minus >= q with erroneous-acceptance probability at most alpha, fixed-sample or sequential. If T accepts on the all-concordant record of length n, then under p_minus = q that record occurs with probability (1-q)^n and leads to acceptance, so alpha >= (1-q)^n, i.e. n >= log(alpha)/log(1-q). Acceptance with fewer pairs is impossible for every valid rule, whatever it does on other records.
lower_bound_for_any_valid_test.scope: the all-concordant record is the most favourable evidence for acceptance; this bounds acceptance cost, not rejection cost; it is a standard likelihood argument, not a new result
lower_bound_for_any_valid_test.equality: the fixed one-sided Clopper-Pearson rule and the point-alternative SPRT both accept at exactly this n on the all-concordant record, so neither can be improved for acceptance on the best path

0.05.source: arXiv:2609.10873v1, rule-specific feasibility n >= log(beta)/log(1-epsilon) with beta = alpha/(4m)

what_32_concordant_pairs_certify.reading: under independent fresh draws with frozen candidate and reference, the existing 32-pair zero-regression outcome already implies p_minus <= 8.94% at 95%; the finite obligation itself claims nothing about unseen conditions

impossibility_within_the_current_budget: q = 0.05 at alpha = 0.05: 59 pairs = 121 runs > 67; not reachable with any valid rule under the current cap
non-inferiority epsilon = 0.05 with the paired-binomial rule: 86 pairs = 175 runs > 67
sequential rules cannot lower these acceptance costs; they lower rejection cost, which the finite obligation can also stop early once the record contract admits a cancellation status

repeated_attempts_control.reading: a frozen-candidate guarantee does not survive swapping the candidate or retrying under the same allocation; the source paper allocates alpha_t = 6 delta / (pi^2 t^2) per attempt so that the sum stays within delta

wall_projection.status: projection from retained per-run cost on this CPU stack; not measured end-to-end savings; excludes preparation, engineering effort, charges and energy

real_records.role: applicability and retrospective calculation on already-exposed records; not fresh evidence, not independent incidents; the recorded order is one ordering and any permutation is descriptive
real_records.data_quality: every trial carries 32 fresh pairs with valid measurements on both sides; both-failed pairs are concordant (X = 0) for the paired contracts and are retained as reference_failed_on_condition by the finite obligation
